name: smwmusic-touhou-koumakyou-the-embodiment-of-the-scarlet-devil-lunar-clock-luna-dial-stage-clear-mix
title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil - Lunar Clock ~ Luna Dial (Stage-Clear-Mix)
description:
Did a short arrangement of Lunar Clock ~ Luna Dial (from Touhou 6 Koumakyou ~ Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil) as a "stage-clear-mix." This one has been on my mind ever since I started these stage clear mixes back with the first one.

Important:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. C# Minor (MIDI Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. C Minor (Original Pitch)

There are also customizable options for enabling & disabling the goal tape sound that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Goal SFX [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables Goal SFX
